name: bubble-call
description: Peer-to-peer video calling with React + WebRTC

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.dev:https: concurrently -n server,client -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev:https --prefix client"
